Protein measurements

Of the plasma samples run, 81 passed the default qc performed in the metaboprep package and instituted by the lab.

For the moment, all 92 measured proteins have been retained for analysis.

See plasmametaboprep_qc_report.html for full details.

Variable definitions

infection

final.diagnosis.1 was used to derive the infection status variables begining with infect.

infect.fct and infect.num are identical 3-level variables, except the first is formatted as factor while the second is formatted as numeric.

The levels of these variables are defined as follows:

  1. Control: final.diagnosis.1= “SPE”
  2. Inter: final.diagnosis.1 = “CPPE”
  3. Case: final.diagnosis.1= “utrue” or final.diagnosis.1= “bacterial”

infect.bi is just the cases from above i.e. infect.num >2

infect.bi.new is infect.bi with N= 0 additional controls included who had final.diagnosis.1 values equal to “X/renal/u”, “X/hepatic/u”, or “X/cardiac/u”.

comp out

comp.out is a variable I received with the title: “composite.outcome..lytics..surgery.or..3m.mortality”

Protein-wide associations

Phenotypic characteristics of participants described in Phenotype information were examined for association with protein abundances (Protein measurements)
